CookingRef contains a list of all known Cooking recipes ingredients and related cooking items. It can be used to find the ingredients to make any cooked item and what cooking recipes an item can be used in. You can also search for recipes matching a partial name. The source for ingredients and recipes is shown such as Expert Farmer or Loot.

Category: Crafting
Updated: 2026-10-06 00:28 UTC
Downloads: 81,437
File: CraftMats_1.13.1.zip (58.4 KB)

Craft Mats is a tool to track crafting materials across multiple characters. It can also list the zones where the materials can be harvested.

It can record a count of each crafting material in a characters inventory and vault and in the shared storage. It will also record what crafting professions each character know and the tiers of crafting known in each profession.

This data allows the plugin to list all the locations where a given material is stored which characters can make use of it and which characters will gain crafting experience from crafting with it.

CraftTimer is based on David Downs Event Timer.
The basic functionality is still the same but in CraftTimer the crafting cool downs will be added and removed to the event list automatically.
So when you craft a relic legendary item or guild item your character item name and initial cool down time will be stored in the list.
